t: When there is not enough to go round
a: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
m: He called for what remained of their provisions, gathered it on a mat, asked for blessing over it, then told them to bring their vessels. Every vessel in the army was filled, and they ate until they were satisfied, and there was still some left.
